what: Opening 'Show the full, unfolded output' under a terminal in a .pair28 card widens the whole card to the unfolded text, so its code, terminal and heading run 485px (390) / 208px (1280) past the panel edge and get clipped, and the folded terminal above stops wrapping. The reader can't scroll to the hidden half. Panel 40 does the same: 400px at 390, 111px at 1280.
evidence: audit with every <details> open: p37 'beyond' h3/pre.code/pre.term.wrap/details.fold-full r=+485 (390), r=+208 (1280); p40 r=+400 / +111. Crops (scratch, deleted after review): review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c28-390-p37.png, c28-1280-p37-open.png. Cause: js-ch28.css:37 `.pair28 > div { display: grid }` with an implicit auto track, sized by the white-space:pre fold-full block.
fix: `.pair28 > div { display: grid; … }` → `.pair28 > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); … }` (an auto grid track grows to its widest pre; minmax(0,1fr) keeps the card at panel width so the wide output scrolls inside its own box)

what: In two-up .duo cards the code box covers the lower half of its file tab, so the 10 file names (lib/fuel.js, cover.test.js, lib/landing_v1.js, lib/landing.js, env.js, flight.env, bin/load_rel.js, bin/load_fixed.js, data/tool-config.json, data/fleet.json) are cut through the middle.
evidence: crop review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c27-1280-p20-filetab.png. js-ch27.css:25 `.duo > div { gap: 6px }` plus the engine's `.file-tab { margin-bottom: -14px }` (comic.css:176) gives an 8px overlap. ch26 and ch28 use gap 14px / margin -10px and are fine.
fix: `.duo > div { gap: 6px }` → `.duo > div .file-tab { margin-bottom: -6px; position: relative; z-index: 1 }` (the tab should sit on the box edge, not under it, as .pair26 does)

what: Code inside .duo cards is forced to `pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere` at 0.9rem, so wrapped lines restart at column 0 with no hanging indent. The indentation that shows the block structure is lost: `throw new TypeError('km must be` / `a number');` and `export function fuelFor(km,` / `litresPerKm = 3) {` both start flush left.
evidence: crop review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c27-390-p20.png (p20 lib/fuel.js and cover.test.js at 390; also at 1280 in the half-width cards). Rule: js-ch27.css:50.
fix: `.duo > div > .code { font-size: 0.9rem; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → delete the rule, and let the code box scroll as every other code box does, or call `L.hangLines()` on its lines (wrapping is only honest if the indent survives)

what: The script-loading table breaks its code tokens letter by letter (`<sc|ript|>`, `def|er`, `typ|e="m|odul|e"`, `asy|nc`), and its fourth column ('Can see the whole page?') is cut off at the right with no cue that the table scrolls.
evidence: crop review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c28-390-p16table.png; audit: div.tablewrap28 scrollWidth 367 in a 330px box. Rule: js-ch28.css:50 `.rules28 code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }`.
fix: `.rules28 code, .rules28 samp { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → `.rules28 code { white-space: nowrap }` plus `@media (max-width: 640px) { .rules28, .rules28 tr, .rules28 td { display: block } .rules28 thead { display: none } }` with a bold label per cell (a 4-column table can't fit 330px; stacking keeps tokens whole and nothing hidden)

what: The version-range table splits version numbers across lines (`^1.4.` / `2`, `~1.4.` / `2`, `1.4.` / `2`, `^0.3.` / `1`). In a panel about reading version numbers, `^1.4.` then `2` reads like a different range.
evidence: crop review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c26-390-p31-bottom.png. Rule: js-ch26.css:54 `.rules26 code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }`.
fix: `.rules26 code, .rules26 samp { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → `.rules26 code { white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal }` (the Range column is wide enough for a 6-character token; a version must never break)

what: The Proofreader's bubble starts with `SyntaxError [ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX]` as plain text. The token has no break points, so it runs 14px past the bubble's right edge and the end of the error code is clipped.
fix: plain `[ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX]` → `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX` (break opportunities after each underscore keep the whole code visible and mark it as code)

what: `.strip` is a grid with an implicit auto column. One unbreakable inline code in an exercise question (ch28 ex-cors `https://tickets.example/api/seats`, ch29 ex-leaks `window.addEventListener('resize', panel.layout)`) widens the whole page column. At 390 every panel on those pages is off-centre: the right gutter is 2px (ch28) and 8px (ch29) instead of 16px, and the hard shadows touch the screen edge.
evidence: measured at 390: main.strip grid-template-columns 371.5px (ch28) and 365.6px (ch29) vs 358px on ch26/27; panels' right edge at 388px / 382px. Hiding only the ex-cors / ex-leaks card brings the column back to 358px. docOverflow is 0, so the checker can't see it. This is the same cause as the `.panel` fix of 11:15, one level up.
fix: `.strip { display: grid; gap: var(--gutter) }` → `.strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--gutter) }` (an auto track sizes to the widest min-content child; minmax(0,1fr) keeps the 16px gutters and makes the long code break or scroll inside its card)

what: The chapter's own robot27 drawing writes its point on the badge ('process' / 'exit 1'). In P27 (the exit-code panel) and P44 it's drawn as .char.sm.robot-sm at 130px, so the badge renders at 5.7–6.1px and 'fs'/'http'/'stream' at 6.1–6.9px. Even at full size they are 7.9–9.8px at 390. sim27's 'CRASH TEST' stamp is 10.4px.
evidence: audit small text: p27/p44 process 5.7px, exit 1 6.1px, fs/http 6.9px, stream 6.1px (both widths); cover process 7.9px, exit 0 8.4px (390); p1 CRASH TEST 10.4px. Crop review-visual-js-26-29/crops/c27-390-p27robot.png. Chapter-local character (js-ch27.js:104–142), so the engine critter pass won't touch it.
fix: `<svg class="char sm robot-sm" data-char="robot27">` → `<svg class="char robot">` inside `.robot-stage` (≥200px), and in js-ch27.js raise the badge text `font-size="14"/"15"` → `"20"` with a 96-unit-wide badge (labels must be ≥12px where the drawing carries the meaning)

what: In the Family Tree room card, 'O(log n)' breaks between 'O(log' and 'n)', which splits the notation the chapter teaches.
evidence: crop a29/w390-037-p22.png (scratch, deleted): '…halves the search: O(log' / 'n), if the tree stays bushy.'

what: The coverage terminal isn't a `.term wrap`, so its command (`node --test --test-reporter=spec --experimental-test-coverage …`) is cut off at the right edge even at 1280. The flag that the prose then discusses ('the flag still says experimental') is out of view. Neighbouring test terminals in P19/P21 do wrap.
evidence: a27/w1280-036-p20.png (scratch, deleted): first terminal line ends '--experime' at the box edge.
fix: `<pre class="term" data-run="cover…">` → `<pre class="term wrap" …>` (the engine wrap keeps a hanging indent; no table line is long enough to need scrolling at 1280)

what: Component consistency: the extensions hand-roll cards and stickers with raw values instead of the engine classes and tokens. `.pair28 > div`, `.library29 .room`, `.book29 li`, `.speed29 li`, `.tdd-step`, `.exhelp26`, `.end-card` and `.win28` use `4px 4px 0 var(--ink)` / `3px 3px 0` shadows and 10/12px radii. The identical `.catch` sticker block is copied into all four files. js-ch28.css:65 overrides the engine option code with `.ex-opt code { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere }`.
evidence: js-ch26.css:12,45; js-ch27.css:17,30; js-ch28.css:24,37,54,65; js-ch29.css:12,45,58,67,88. DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3 maps cards to .duo-card with --radius-lg and --shadow-hard/--shadow-hard-lg.
fix: `box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); border-radius: 12px` → `box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard); border-radius: var(--radius-lg)` (or reuse `.duo-card`); promote `.catch` to comic.css once and delete the four copies; delete the `.ex-opt code` override (one card system, one set of tokens)
